title: Repair the Ticket Router
tagline: Ask a human when the AI is guessing
objective: Turn a shaky guess into a decision somebody actually made.
description: This router reads a support ticket, picks a category, and files it. A Validator already checks that the category is one you allow and that the model was at least 70% sure. But when the model is unsure, the Validator simply kills the run - the ticket vanishes and nobody is told. Change what the Validator does on failure so a low-confidence guess pauses for a person, who can confirm or correct the category before the ticket is routed.

sample_input.subject: Invoice looks wrong again
sample_input.body: This is the second month my invoice has an extra seat on it. I removed that person in March. Can someone look at this before the next charge goes out?

expected_output: A routed ticket carrying an allowed category, the classifier's summary, and a routing status - after a person confirmed or corrected the category.

config.prompt: Classify this support ticket. Return JSON with category (one of billing, technical, account, feedback), summary, suggested_queue and confidence (a number between 0 and 1 for how sure you are).
config.system: You triage support tickets. Choose only from the allowed categories.

config.review_prompt: The classifier is not confident about this ticket. Confirm the category or correct it.

solution_hint: Open 'Is the category trustworthy?' and change 'When validation fails' from 'Fail the run' to 'Ask a human'. Re-run: the workflow pauses and shows you the shaky classification. Approve it, or edit the category, and the ticket carries on to the Output.

failure_scenarios.label: The classifier is confused
failure_scenarios.description: The model returns a category it is only 30% sure about - well under the 70% bar the Validator enforces.

completion_criteria: The category is checked against the list of allowed categories
A shaky guess pauses for a person instead of killing the run
A human decision is recorded on the run
The routed ticket reaches the Output with a category on it
The run finishes instead of failing

data.summary: Customer was charged for a seat they removed in March and wants it fixed before the next invoice.
